【與角色對話，在字裡行間捕捉線索】
眾多NPC各有獨立故事與行為邏輯，談話中的閃爍其詞、細節的偏差，都可能成為揭穿偽裝的關鍵線索。點擊角色就能標記「好人」或「狼人」，標對就能解鎖新提示，全程沒有複雜操作，新手也能輕輕鬆鬆上手。

【多重謎題，每一步都決定結局】
從對話選擇到線索拼合，每個決策都會影響調查方向。多重關卡逐級升級，每局2-5分鐘就能完成，純文字推理燒腦又解压，適合碎片時間玩，揪出所有狼人，才能驅散迷霧，守護小鎮。

《凹嗚殺：狼人在身邊》——真相，從來不只一面。
挑戰你的推理極限，在真話與謊言之間，做出最終審判，一起走進這場充滿玄機的文字迷宮吧。

Play as a troublemaking gnome with AI buddies and complete a set number of pranks to win. Smash objects, steal valuables, flush items down the toilet, or devour anything you find — every prank brings you closer to victory and makes grandpa furious.

But beware: grandpa is always hunting the gnomes. If he catches one of you, the punishment gets harsher each time. He might throw you outside, flush you away, or eliminate you from the mission. Lose too many teammates and your prank operation falls apart.

Watch out for traps hidden throughout the house — one wrong step and grandpa can capture a gnomes intruder instantly.

Features:

• Hilarious stealth & prank gameplay
• Command a squad of chaotic gnomes
• Dozens of creative mischief objectives
• Increasing difficulty as grandpa gets angrier
• Hidden traps and dynamic hazards
• Fast, fun, and unpredictable rounds

top_apps.name: Demo Slot
top_apps.description_short: Leap from a magic carpet, catch shiny rubies and conquer the Demo Slot
top_apps.description_excerpt:
Unleash the spirit of an Arabian adventure and dive into the golden sands with Demo Slot!
Welcome to a beautifully crafted, fast-paced vertical arcade game that takes you high above sun-drenched dunes and majestic desert palaces. In Demo Slot, your royal fighter is ready to plunge straight down into the warm desert breeze starting from the edge of a legendary flying carpet. Forget about heavy parachute packs or safety ropes—this is a rapid, action-packed freefall where your sense of timing determines your ultimate high score. Watch the sky closely, find the perfect second, and see how many mystic treasures you can gather on your way down.
Simple One-Touch Action
This casual simulator is tailored for quick, satisfying gaming sessions whenever you need a quick break. Choose your starting stakes before the round begins, hit the large golden play button, and watch an automated descent unfold. Your character navigates the desert sky completely on his own, making the gameplay incredibly smooth and accessible for everyone.
Snatch Magic Lamps and Precious Rubies

top_apps.name: Fanseen: Horror Game
top_apps.description_short: She wants to play with you...
top_apps.description_excerpt:
She was left alone in this mansion… and she’s starting to get bored.
If she sees you or hears even the slightest sound, she will come after you.
Are you ready for the chase?

You wake up at midnight inside a labyrinth-like mansion.
With two floors and a basement, the only way out of this dark house is unlocking its sealed doors.

But stay quiet.
A dropped object or a small noise can reveal your location.
You can hide in closets, under beds, in bathrooms, or even inside washing machines.

Some doors require focus and courage.
Solve mini-games, progress forward, and try to escape this house.

Upgrade your abilities in the shop, choose your power-ups, and climb to the top of the leaderboard.
